summary: Space Shuttle Atlantis successfully launched this morning after four years of inactivity, lifting off from Launch Complex 39B at the Kennedy Space Center at 15:14:55 GMT and reaching orbit about 8 1/2 minutes later, with television coverage including a live camera on the external fuel tank that remained on after separation. Early indications suggest there was no serious damage caused by foam debris that was responsible for the loss of Space Shuttle Columbia in February 2003, and the six‑astronaut mission marks the resumption of the International Space Station assembly program begun in 1998 and halted after the Columbia disaster, with Atlantis set to install a truss section and solar panels.
